verdict.rationale: Solid's README states that state management is built in through Context and Stores, so you don't need a third-party library for global state (solid-gh-2). It also documents fine-grained reactive state with automatic dependency tracking, used throughout the app (solid-gh-1, solid-gh-10, solid-gh-11). A long-term user reports that state changes stay intuitive on a large product (solid-comm-10). missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the Store/Context APIs beyond README-level claims, and independent hands-on corroboration specifically of global-state management without external libraries.
